faqData.question: What's the dress code?
faqData.answer: Entourage in coffee brown—from deep espresso to warm camel. Guests in nude tones: soft blush, sand, and champagne—elegant shades that complement the day without matching the entourage palette.

faqData.question: Food allergies or dietary needs?
faqData.answer: Please let us know if you need a vegetarian meal. We also need to be mindful of a crustacean allergy when planning the menu.

faqData.question: Can I bring a plus-one?
faqData.answer: Our celebration is intimate — invitations are addressed to those named on the invite only, so plus-ones are not included.

faqData.question: Are children welcome?
faqData.answer: We love your little ones, but this will be an adults-only evening — only children who are specifically invited on your invitation may attend.
